title: Bring back unit tests & introduce test coverage
description:
Currently the whole TestTools are unusable - the spec has completely changed and they need to be reworked to follow ProjectTools and StoryTools.
The test writing and reading is done via FileTools - the only concern of the TestTools should be the general running of tests.
We need to be able to run python and javascript/typescript tests (similar to how the current `runTest` functions for python) - the function needs to work out the language based on the extension.
There needs to be a function `runTestCoverage` that will provide test coverage in a standardised way (i.e. as a json object) specifying some standard information per file:
- % statements
- %branch
- % functions
- %lines
- lines not covered by tests

features.title: Refactor TestTools to Remove File Operations
features.description: Modify `src/tools/TestTools.ts` to remove the `getTest`, `updateTest`, and `deleteTest` functions. This change aligns with the new architecture where `TestTools` is responsible only for test execution, not file management. Ensure the `createTestTools` factory function is updated to export only the test execution functions and correctly utilizes the `getTestPath` helper from `src/utils.ts`.

features.title: Implement Language-Aware `runTest` Function
features.description: Update the `runTest` function in `src/tools/TestTools.ts` to support both Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. The function must detect the language from the file extension. Use `python3` for `.py` files and `vitest` for `.js`, `.jsx`, `.ts`, and `.tsx` files. The function should properly resolve the test file path using `getTestPath`.

features.title: Implement `runTestCoverage` for Python
features.description: Add a new `runTestCoverage` function to `src/tools/TestTools.ts` to generate test coverage reports for Python files. Use the 'coverage' library to produce a JSON report, then parse it to create a standardized JSON object containing per-file statistics for statement, branch, function, and line coverage, plus a list of uncovered lines.

features.title: Extend `runTestCoverage` to Support JavaScript/TypeScript
features.description: Enhance the `runTestCoverage` function to also support JavaScript and TypeScript. Use `vitest`'s built-in coverage reporting to generate a JSON output. This output must be parsed and transformed into the same standardized JSON format used for Python coverage reports to ensure consistent results across languages.

features.title: Update Tool Composition and Documentation
features.description: Update `src/tools/Tools.ts` to correctly integrate the refactored `TestTools`, reflecting the removal of file operation methods and the addition of `runTestCoverage`. Also, update `docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md` to document the new `TestTools` API and the standardized test coverage report format.
